title: Donald Trumps in the Virtual Polls: Predicting Public Opinions Using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the LLM with demographic personas from the World Values Survey (WVS) and American National Election Studies (ANES) to simulate survey responses and voting behavior, and comparing the synthetic outputs against actual human data to detect systematic progressive, moralistic, and law-abiding deviations on value-laden topics (e.g., LGBTQ+ rights, gender roles).

Evaluating the LLM's ability to replicate cross-cultural differences by comparing synthetic responses generated for U.S. and Chinese personas against actual human survey responses from both nations, measuring whether the model captures or homogenizes distinct cultural nuances and values.
